text.text: Melee hits load 1 bullet into the chamber, up to 3. Right-click to fire loaded bullets as fast projectiles inheriting tool traits; each shot costs 1 durability; fire cooldown shrinks with attack speed. The gunblade has a 1-slot chamber holding any Tinkers throwable: chamber ammo throws the projectile itself (shurikens, throwing axes, snowballs), with a slightly longer cooldown. Sneak-use to load or eject a projectile.
